The '''Betshish system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Gordian Reach/Legends|Gordian Reach]], found within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of the galaxy.<ref name="eao">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref>
